name: Sports
one_liner: Leagues, teams, and venues monetizing fan passion through media rights, tickets, and sponsorship, where scarce live content commands rising prices.
how_it_makes_money: Leagues sell national media rights and share them among teams, while teams earn ticket and premium-seating revenue, local media, sponsorships, and merchandise. Adjacent businesses include venues and events, sports betting partnerships, and franchise value appreciation for owners.
revenue_formula: Team revenue = media share + ticketing + sponsorship + merchandise + concessions
Ticketing revenue = games × attendance × average ticket price
Media rights value = viewers × ad value per viewer + subscription value to distributor
cost_structure: Player salaries: the largest team cost, often governed by salary caps tied to league revenue
Venue operations: stadium maintenance, staff, and game-day costs
Debt service on franchise purchases and stadium construction
margins: Team operating margins are often modest or thin because player salaries absorb much of revenue, but franchise values have appreciated strongly. Media deals, market size, and venue ownership drive the spread.

key_metrics.name: Media rights value
key_metrics.what: Annual fees paid by broadcasters and streamers; the largest and most stable revenue source for major leagues.

key_metrics.name: Attendance and sell-through
key_metrics.what: Share of seats sold; drives ticket, concession, and sponsor value.

key_metrics.name: Revenue per fan / per attendee
key_metrics.what: Spending on tickets, food, and merchandise; measures monetization of engagement.

key_metrics.name: Franchise valuation
key_metrics.what: Market value of teams; key for owners and investors.

key_metrics.name: Viewership
key_metrics.what: TV and streaming audience; underpins media rights and sponsorship pricing.

key_metrics.name: Salary cap / payroll ratio
key_metrics.what: Player costs as a share of revenue; determines team profitability.

trends: Media rights moving to streaming platforms as leagues split packages across TV and tech companies
Rapid growth of legalized sports betting and league-sportsbook partnerships
Private equity and institutional investors buying minority stakes in teams
Rise of women's sports as a fast-growing audience and investment category
College sports changing with athlete compensation and conference realignment
Premium venue experiences and mixed-use stadium districts
